ad_intro:
The Derma Co (thedermaco.com, founded 2020 by Varun & Ghazal Alagh, Honasa Consumer) is India's fastest-growing actives-based derma skincare brand, crossing Rs.1,000 Cr annual revenue in FY26 and hitting EBITDA positive. We identified ~95 active creatives running across Meta in India, spending an estimated Rs.3-4 Cr/mo on hero SKUs: 1% Hyaluronic Sunscreen Aqua Gel (SPF 50 PA++++), 10% Vitamin C Serum, 2% Kojic Acid Serum, 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash, and acne patches.

Three obvious leaks in the funnel: (1) Heavy promo + doctor-led creative, thin real-customer UGC - ads are dominated by 'X% off' discount hooks plus dermatologist-as-spokesperson shots, while customer before/after transformation, texture demos and 30-day journey reels are thin even though beauty benchmarks show before/after UGC delivers 2.3x higher ROAS than brand creative. (2) Discount anchoring erodes AOV and retention - high %-off promos train buyers to deal-hunt; sunscreens and serums are replenishment goods, not impulse buys, and the creative under-indexes on regimen/routine bundling. (3) Portfolio audience bleed + weak SKU retargeting - running inside Honasa alongside Mamaearth/Aqualogica/Dr Sheth's/BBlunt without cross-brand suppression, plus PDP-view to ATC retargeting appears generic-brand rather than SKU-specific before/after.

Competitive heat is rising: Foxtale raised $56.8M (Series C) and runs 87% PDP-routed ads with heavy close-up before/after UGC, Deconstruct is Kalaari/Beenext-backed ingredient-minimalism, and Minimalist (HUL-owned) dominates ingredient-percentage trust. With Honasa pushing Derma Co + Dr Sheth's as the next growth engine to a Rs.5,000 Cr group target by 2030, ad efficiency directly compounds. We estimate 35-45% of ad spend is leaking; HOT lead.

findings: Creative leak: Ad mix is heavy on discount announcements ("Flat 30% off", "Buy 2 Get 1") and dermatologist-spokesperson studio shots, while real-customer transformation content (28-day acne clearing, 30-day pigmentation fade, texture close-ups, application routine) is thin. Skincare benchmarks (Monaqo/Agora 2025) show before/after UGC delivers 2.3x ROAS over brand creative in beauty, with before/after-with-specific-concern identification being the winning format. The derm-cred positioning is strong but overused as the only hook, making creative feel repetitive.

Copy leak - discount anchoring: Headlines over-index on price/promo ("Flat 30% off", "Starting Rs.299") rather than skin-outcome ("Active acne in 14 days", "Pigmentation -60% in 28 days"). For actives-based derma skincare at Rs.300-800 price points, buyers choose on clinical proof + peer results before price. Heavy discounting also trains repeat purchase behavior to wait for sales, eroding replenishment LTV in a category where 45-90 day repeat is the profit engine.

Landing page leak: PDPs lead with offer banners and product beauty shots, but texture-close-up GIFs, in-use demo videos, day-by-day result carousels, and regimen-bundling ("Complete your 3-step AM routine") sit below the fold. Sticky ATC on mobile shows price but not star-rating + review count + 'X people bought this in last 24h' social proof. Quiz/routine-finder exists but ad traffic lands on SKU PDPs rather than concern-specific routine pages.

Tracking & portfolio leak: As a Honasa brand sharing ad accounts/infrastructure with Mamaearth, Aqualogica, BBlunt and Dr Sheth's, there is likely audience bleed (a buyer of Mamaearth Ubtan face wash doesn't want Derma Co salicylic ads served to them) and CAPI event dedup between sister brands needs verification. Retargeting appears to use generic brand creative rather than SKU-specific before/after per audience (PDP-view-no-ATC, ATC-no-purchase, past-purchaser cross-sell, replenishment-at-45-days).

wins: WIN 1 - Creative: 30 Real-Customer Transformation UGC Reels (28-Day Journeys, Texture, Derm Q&A)

Shoot 30 vertical Reels monthly: (a) 8 before/after 14/28-day journeys (acne clearing, pigmentation fade, open-pores tightening, sunscreen glow) with real customers and specific day-stamps, (b) 8 texture + application demos ("sinks in 30 seconds", "no white cast", "pill-free under makeup"), (c) 6 derm-Q&A educational clips (not selling - "Can I use salicylic + niacinamide together?") to build trust, (d) 4 routine-integration clips (AM/PM for oily/acne-prone), (e) 4 unsponsored-looking unboxing/first-impression clips from micro-creators (10K-100K). Pair every promo ad with a UGC variant per ad set; cap promo-led creative at 30% of spend. Expected: ROAS +40-60% on top-spend SKUs, CPA -25-35%. Before/after UGC is the highest-ROAS format in Indian skincare per 2026 benchmarks.
WIN 2 - CRO: Outcome-First PDPs + Regimen Bundles + Sticky Social-Proof ATC

On top 10 SKUs: move the hero banner from 'Flat X% off' to an outcome statement ("28 days to visibly clearer acne") with small offer badge; add texture GIF, 15-second in-use video and day-1/7/14/28 result strip above the fold; add sticky mobile ATC with price, star rating, review count and 'X bought in last 24h' FOMO; introduce concern-specific regimen bundles (AM + PM for acne-prone; pigmentation routine) at 10% bundle discount vs single-SKU discounting, which lifts AOV 25-40%; route ad traffic to concern-landing pages (acne/pigmentation/suncare) rather than SKU PDPs where users can self-select into a 3-step routine. Add a lightweight 'Find your routine' quiz on the landing page (3-4 questions) that routes to bundle pages. Expected: PDP CVR +30-45%, AOV +20-25%.
WIN 3 - Tracking: Honasa Portfolio CAPI + Sister-Brand Suppression + SKU Replenishment Loops

Audit Meta CAPI across Honasa brands for proper server-side event dedup and cross-brand user stitching. Add audience suppression between sister brands (if user purchased Mamaearth or Aqualogica in last 60 days, don't serve Derma Co retinol/sunscreen ads unless they explicitly engaged with Derma Co content) to stop portfolio cannibalization. Build 5 SKU-specific retargeting audiences: (1) PDP-view no ATC -> texture demo + derm explanation, (2) ATC no purchase -> review snippets + small offer, (3) first-purchase at 30 days -> rest-of-routine cross-sell, (4) replenishment reminders at 45/60/75 days for sunscreens/serums/washes, (5) past 2x+ buyers -> VIP early access + referral. Add a 'subscribe & save' option for replenishment SKUs. Expected: retargeting ROAS +50-80%, repeat rate +15-25%, cannibalization waste cut ~20%.
